headline: 84 G/T GOLD AND 15% ANTIMONY IN A SINGLE INTERCEPT — ALKANE'S TRUE BLUE VEIN EXTENDS COSTERFIELD'S HIGH-GRADE CORRIDOR (ASX:ALK)
snippet: Alkane Resources Ltd. (ASX:ALK) released its July 6, 2026 True Blue exploration update reporting high-grade results from an additional 33 drill holes targeting the Freeman veining at the Costerfield Operation in central Victoria, Australia — highlights include 57.6 g/t Au and 25.4% Sb over 0.25m in TB055 and 84.1 g/t Au and 15.4% Sb over 0.48m in TB084. True Blue sits 2 km west of Alkane's active underground mine and represents the company's primary resource extension target. Antimony — subject to China's September 2024 export controls and in acute demand for military munitions and battery technology — adds a critical minerals premium to what is already a world-class high-grade Victorian gold deposit. An updated True Blue resource estimate is expected as part of Alkane's upcoming annual Resource and Reserves Statement, with drilling continuing through FY26-27 targeting the deposit along strike and at depth below the Komodo Fault.

headline: DAKOTA GOLD WRAPS 17,273M PRE-FEAS DRILL AT RICHMOND HILL — 77.19 G/T AU IN EXPANSION HOLE, MINE-PLAN MODEL DUE Q4 2026 (NYSE:DC)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Dakota Gold Corp. (NYSE American: DC)
snippet: Dakota Gold Corp. (NYSE American: DC) completed its 2026 Pre-Feasibility Study drill campaign at the Richmond Hill Oxide Heap Leach Gold Project in the Black Hills of South Dakota on July 6, 2026 — 17,273 metres across 112 infill, expansion, and geotechnical holes. The latest assay batch includes expansion hole RH26C-432, which returned 11.36 g/t Au and 14.92 g/t Ag over 26.3 metres, with a high-grade core of 77.19 g/t Au and 63.12 g/t Ag over 3.2 metres. Data from the combined 2025-2026 campaigns feeds directly into a PFS due Q4 2026, which will include an updated mineral resource estimate, a refined geo-metallurgical model, and a single optimized mine plan with sequencing for this near-surface oxide heap-leach deposit. Richmond Hill is one of the few NYSE-listed junior gold development projects in a Tier-1 US jurisdiction currently at the PFS stage — the completion of drilling is the critical path milestone before formal construction economics can be published.

headline: PROVENANCE DRILLS 116.74M OF 1.82 G/T AU AT ELDORADO WEST OREGON — GOLD SYSTEM EXPANDS SOUTH, NEW FUNDED 2026 DRILL STARTS JULY (CSE:PAU)
snippet: Provenance Gold Corp. (CSE:PAU) released final assay results from the 2025 core drilling program at its Eldorado West Project in Eastern Oregon on July 6, 2026 — hole EC-09 returned 1.82 g/t Au over 116.74m including 4.70 g/t Au over 25.60m and an 8.31 g/t Au high-grade core over 12.34m. Hole EC-08 tested a previously undrilled area well south of the Tyee Area and intersected significant gold mineralisation, indicating the system extends materially beyond current modelling in both the north-south and east-west directions. Provenance plans to commence a new fully funded and permitted 2026 core drilling program at Eldorado West in July 2026 with Titan Drilling Ltd. The consecutive 100m+ gold intervals across multiple independent holes establish Eldorado West as a bulk-tonnage target with meaningful grade, in a US jurisdiction that has attracted renewed interest from developers positioning ahead of a potential domestic gold M&A wave at $4,100/oz gold.

headline: PACIFICA SILVER FINDS LARGE VOLCANIC CHARGEABILITY ANOMALY AT CLAUDIA — DRILL IMMEDIATELY DIVERTED TO NEW 'JUDY' TARGET, DURANGO MEXICO (CSE:PSIL)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Pacifica Silver Corp. (CSE:PSIL)
snippet: Pacifica Silver Corp. (CSE:PSIL) announced July 6, 2026 that its first Induced Polarization survey at the Claudia Silver-Gold Project in Durango State, Mexico — 31.65 line kilometres — identified a large, near-surface, volcanic-rock-hosted chargeability anomaly in the southern property area. The company immediately redirected one drill rig from its ongoing Phase II program to begin an initial five-hole test of the new "Judy" anomaly. This is the first time the Claudia property has been systematically mapped for concealed sulfide targets using modern IP geophysics — the southern volcanic-hosted anomaly introduces a second mineralization model alongside the Justina Vein system, which was extended to 600 metres of strike length in 2025 with high-grade gold and silver intercepts. IP-identified near-surface volcanic chargeability anomalies in Mexican epithermal districts have historically been strong guides to blind sulfide-rich mineralization; the immediate drill diversion signals the company's own geological confidence in the new target's merit.

headline: ROSLAND CAPITAL FILES CHAPTER 11 — 617 CUSTOMERS OWED $49M IN UNDELIVERED GOLD, WILLIAM DEVANE'S DEALER BECOMES A CAUTIONARY TALE
snippet: Rosland Capital LLC — the Los Angeles gold and silver dealer best known for Fox News commercials featuring actor William Devane — filed Chapter 11 liquidation on July 2, 2026, listing $50-$100 million in liabilities against $1-10 million in assets and leaving 617 customers owed approximately $49 million in undelivered orders and unfulfilled repurchase obligations. Money Metals Exchange's July 6 analysis identifies the structural cause: Rosland ran a "sell today, buy tomorrow" model that couldn't close the gap as gold surged from $1,500 to $5,400 — company revenue fell from $151M (2021) to $97.8M (2025) while cumulative losses since 2022 exceeded $24 million. Rosland joins Regal Assets, Red Rock Secured, Chase Metals, Oxford Gold Group, and Safeguard Metals in a growing list of dealer failures during the gold bull market. The article's practical lesson for retail investors: counterparty risk is highest when gold dealers hold inventory or delivery obligations on a leveraged basis, making segregated allocated storage with a physical delivery guarantee the key differentiator in a bull market environment.

headline: AIRBORNE SURVEY LAUNCHES ACROSS WORLD'S LARGEST UNDEVELOPED URANIUM MRE — DISTRICT METALS MAPS VIKEN'S ALUM SHALE IN SWEDEN (TSXV:DMX)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / District Metals Corp. (TSXV:DMX)
snippet: District Metals Corp. (TSXV:DMX) commenced a 2,253-line-kilometre helicopter-borne MobileMT geophysical survey on July 6, 2026 across its Alum Shale Properties in north-central Sweden, covering the Jämtland and Västerbottens Counties at 400-metre line spacing. The Viken Property within the Alum Shale Properties hosts what District Metals describes as the largest undeveloped uranium Mineral Resource Estimate in the world, alongside significant resource estimates for vanadium, potash, molybdenum, nickel, copper, zinc, and other critical materials. A 2025 MobileMT survey successfully mapped the mineralized Alum Shale host rock of the Viken deposit, validating the technique; the 2026 program extends coverage across the full Alum Shale Properties to identify priority drill targets beyond Viken's known boundary. Sweden legalized uranium mining in 2022 — making the Viken deposit, in a NATO country with a modern critical minerals regulatory framework, an increasingly strategic asset as Western governments seek non-Chinese uranium and critical minerals supply chains.

headline: PPX CALLANQUITAS POSTS BACK-TO-BACK MONTHLY NPI RECORDS — 2026'S FIRST 5 MONTHS ALREADY TOPS ENTIRE 2025 AT $4,000+ GOLD (TSX.V:PPX)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / PPX Mining Corp. (TSX.V:PPX)
snippet: PPX Mining Corp. (TSX.V:PPX) reported July 6, 2026 that the Callanquitas underground mine at its Igor Project in northern Peru generated a Net Profit Interest of PEN 14.67 million in May 2026 — its second consecutive all-time monthly record, exceeding April 2026's then-record of PEN 12.59 million by approximately 16.5%. Cumulative NPI for January–May 2026 reached PEN 50.56 million, already surpassing the PEN 47.69 million generated across all of fiscal 2025 — with the trailing twelve-month NPI at a record PEN 91.41 million. PPX's NPI-based revenue structure passes operating cost risk to Callanquitas's operator while PPX participates directly in margin expansion: with gold above $4,000/oz, the operational leverage flowing through to NPI holders is running at a pace the company has never seen before. A new processing plant is under construction at Igor, and consecutive record months alongside active plant construction is the type of operational momentum that historically catalyses junior re-ratings in the 6-12 months preceding new production capacity.
